Strong submission. Assess criteria.

C1: Excellent — several issues, org context, stakeholders table. 10.
C2: Excellent — arguments for/against with depth, conclusions for multiple stakeholders (recommendations per stakeholder). 10.
C3: Excellent — compelling, structured, systematic. 10.
C4: Excellent — references, quantitative (19,000 appointments, $475M, $4.3B) and qualitative. 10.
C5: Very good/Excellent — fluent, tables + figure, IEEE references. Minor: heading levels inconsistent, abstract slightly over 150 words (~170). I'd give 9? Levels only allow 10 or 8... whole number within level range; Excellent min 10 max 10, Very good 8. Give 8? The writing is excellent; visual elements: one figure, two tables — "several types" arguably. Minor formatting inconsistencies (heading levels). I'll give 8 (Very good) due to minor heading inconsistencies and abstract length. Actually rubric says "no incorrect uses of language" — fine. I'll give 8.
